# iOS message action captures

These screenshots show the generated `--preview-data --preview-contact-chat --preview-menu-test-chat` fixture with expanded media. Names, messages, and images are synthetic test content; no production conversation or account data is included.

- `portrait-menu.png`: only the held portrait is presented with its actions.
- `portrait-return.png`: the group and caption remain after dismissal.

Particle submission is validated by the focused Metal-rendering UI checks; these still images do not claim to measure animation smoothness.
